macos_signed_reader_commands.clock: elapsed nanoseconds per local command, including JSON, IPC and filesystem output for MHTML

macos_signed_metalink_downloads.method: Six alternating pairs per archive, from signed app download command through observed completion. Each first pair also tested rejection with an incorrect Metalink SHA-256. Both downloads created by the preceding build were reopened by the checked build.

macos_in_memory_hashing.method: Twelve alternating pairs per algorithm and input. Both thin-LTO, single-codegen-unit release binaries hash the same resident bytes with the same partitions. A separate Python digest verifies the warmup and each timed digest matches that warmup.

linux_avx2_sha512_prototype.method: Separate x86-64 AVX2 prototype on Linux. Twelve alternating pairs per archive. Each sample hashes the resident input three times with 256 KiB updates. Expected SHA-512 digests were derived independently in Python.
